notes: All archived names are repository-relative original paths. artifact-map maps repeated guest aliases to the retained unique bytes.

Full differential/native-host replay guest binaries, compiler/Node/C-tool executables, the Wasmtime shared library and original SDK binary archive are omitted; hashes, versions and commands are retained in reports. Installed Goose stdlib sources, SDK headers and native host build manifest are retained.
Original experiment reports keep collection-time absolute paths and fingerprints; compiler inputs are retained as source snapshots and patches for each rejected experiment.
Profiles and timing-instrumented probes are separate from ordinary process headline timings.
